sloka: भंगम् धनुः च तूणी च विकीर्णाम् बहुधा रथम् ।संभ्रांत हृदयो रामः शशंस भ्रातरम् प्रियम् ॥३-६४-३८॥
transliteration: bhaṁgam dhanuḥ ca tūṇī ca vikīrṇām bahudhā ratham ।saṁbhrāṁta hṛdayo rāmaḥ śaśaṁsa bhrātaram priyam ॥3-64-38॥

translations.english: Bewildered to see the broken bow and quiver and many splinters of the chariot scattered all over, Rama said to his loving brother Lakshmana:
